summary.text: Use the Termination of ElderShield e-Service. Ending it means losing all existing benefits.

details.heading: What you will lose
details.body: You will lose all existing benefits if you terminate your policy.

details.heading: If you later join CareShield Life
details.body: You may have to go for a medical assessment if you wish to join CareShield Life.

details.heading: Consider keeping your policy
details.body: MOH encourages you to consider keeping your ElderShield policy for basic long-term care protection.

steps.name: Terminate your policy
steps.text: Use the Termination of ElderShield e-Service to end your ElderShield policy.

quotes.text: You can terminate your ElderShield via the Termination of ElderShield e-Service if you do not wish to continue to be covered under the scheme.
You can terminate your ElderShield via the Termination of ElderShield e-Service
However, you will lose all existing benefits
you may have to go for a medical assessment if you wish to join CareShield Life
